consumer_rules: Consumers read a pinned copy (or vendored mirror with provenance) of this manifest and the referenced CSV.
Consumers MUST verify the CSV SHA-256 against this manifest and fail closed on mismatch.
Consumers MUST record the mapping_version they resolved with.
Consumers MUST NOT edit, extend, fork or re-derive the mapping locally; new rules are proposed in retailpulses/.github/business/mercari/taxonomy and approved there.
A category decision is not a publish decision: listing upload, Seller writes and runtime activation require separate authorization.

row_status_field.note: Retained so consumer enums do not break. Superseded by approval_status in this manifest and the approval record in category-mapping-policy.md.

order: exact approved rule for the Giga category code
more specific approved rule qualified by product_kind_key / selector hint
approved scoped fallback for the same supplier family
resolution_contract.ambiguity_rule: When one Giga code maps to more than one Mercari leaf and no qualified rule resolves deterministically, the result stays unresolved; never guess or default silently.
resolution_contract.id_handling: Mercari category IDs are case-sensitive 20-22 character strings; never cast, normalize or uppercase them.

known_gaps.note: Tool boxes / tool cabinets have no approved relation yet; they remain UNRESOLVED.
